description: Evidence-tracked metadata registry. It does not contain executable formulas or replace runtime calculation engines.

constraints: All monetary, hour, bonus, rate and deduction inputs must be finite and nonnegative.
Overtime multiplier must be positive.
Tax and retirement percentages must not exceed 100; fixed benefits plus other deductions cannot exceed gross pay.
units: Monetary values use the UI-selected currency where applicable; percentages are percentage points; hours and employee counts retain their entered units.
calculation.precision: JavaScript Number arithmetic; UI formatting is separate from calculation precision.
calculation.rounding: No calculation rounding unless explicitly described by the function; UI formatting is separate.
assumptions: One-pay-period estimate; withholding and employment rules vary by location.
The entered deductions are treated as flat amounts or percentages exactly as supplied.
sourceReferences: tests/formula.test.cjs#Paycheck calculator separates regular, overtime and deductions

constraints: Opening cash, monthly inflows, monthly outflows and both growth rates must be finite non-negative numbers
Monthly inflow and outflow growth rates must not exceed 100%
Projection period must be exactly 3, 6, 12 or 24 months
calculation.formula: For month t=1..periods: inflow_t=inflows*(1+inflowGrowth/100)^(t-1); outflow_t=outflows*(1+outflowGrowth/100)^(t-1); closingCash_t=openingCash_t+inflow_t-outflow_t; openingCash_(t+1)=closingCash_t; endingCash=closingCash_periods; totalInflows=sum(inflow_t); totalOutflows=sum(outflow_t); netCashChange=endingCash-opening
units: currency

months
calculation.precision: JavaScript Number floating-point; no explicit rounding in calculation core
calculation.rounding: No rounding in core; display formatting is handled by the UI
assumptions: Monthly inflows and outflows recur and compound using fixed user-entered growth rates
Growth is compounded from month 1 with exponent t−1
Timing within each month, tax, financing and seasonality are excluded
Negative projected cash balances are retained as scenario outputs

constraints: All nine inputs must be finite, nonnegative numeric balance-sheet amounts; zero is valid.
calculation.formula: totalAssets = cash + investments + property + vehicles + otherAssets; totalLiabilities = mortgage + loans + cards + otherDebt; netWorth = totalAssets - totalLiabilities.
units: All monetary inputs and outputs use the same user-selected display currency; series order is assets, liabilities, net worth.
calculation.precision: JavaScript Number arithmetic; no explicit rounding in calculation core.
calculation.rounding: No rounding is applied by the calculation function; display formatting is handled by the UI.
assumptions: Point-in-time estimate based solely on user-entered current balances; property and vehicle values are entered estimates; no automatic valuation or currency conversion occurs within this function.
sourceReferences: app.js#net-worth tool definition and Core.netWorthCalculator argument mapping

constraints: Value must be finite; places must be an integer from 0 to 12; scaled value must remain finite; mode must be nearest, up or down.
calculation.formula: scale=10^places; up uses ceil(value*scale)/scale; down uses floor(value*scale)/scale; nearest uses Math.round(value*scale+EPSILON)/scale (the positive epsilon preserves JavaScript tie-toward-positive-infinity behavior for negative halves).
units: Dimensionless mathematical values; no currency or physical units are applied.
calculation.precision: JavaScript Number arithmetic; Number.EPSILON adjustment for nearest mode.
calculation.rounding: Explicit mode-dependent rounding to 0–12 decimal places.
